avSummary: deliver 15, Arm 14, loose 2, armed men 2, prepared 2, take 2, army 1, make fat 1, put off 1, delivered out 1, draw out 1, armed soldiers 1, withdrawn 1
definition:
1) to remove, draw out, draw off, take off, withdraw, equip (for war),
    arm for war, rescue, be rescued
    1a) (Qal) equipped (participle)
    1b) (Niphal)
        1b1) to be equipped
        1b2) to go equipped
        1b3) to be armed
    1c) (Hiphil)
        1c1) to make strong, brace up
        1c2) to invigorate
 2) to draw off or out, withdraw
    2a) (Qal)
        2a1) to draw, draw off
        2a2) to withdraw
    2b) (Niphal)
        2b1) to be delivered
        2b2) to be saved
    2c) (Piel)
        2c1) to pull out, tear out
        2c2) to rescue, deliver, set free
        2c3) to take away, plunder
